name: De/Ascend
summary: De/Ascend is a first-person survival horror game with FMV elements. Waking up in a locked-down underground facility with no memory of your past, you must ascend from its lowest depths and escape its horrors while pursued by a monstrous entity that always knows exactly where you are.
